- **Critical Repairs Required Before `VIABLE`:**
  1. **Corrupted GLS/OLS $R^2$ Broadcasting Bug:** In [`fit_pgls`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/scripts/02_pgls_ancestry_models.py#L49-L80), subtracting `(n, 1)` `ones_tilde * mu_null` from `(n,)` `y_tilde` broadcasts to `(237, 237)` and inflates `rss_null` 237-fold, producing $R^2 \approx 0.999$ across [pgls_lambda_profile.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/results/pgls_lambda_profile.tsv), [pgls_sensitivity.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/results/pgls_sensitivity.tsv), and [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/DOSSIER.md#L93-L135) instead of the true $R^2 = 0.46905$ (primary PGLS) and $0.49579$ (OLS).
  2. **Biased ML Residual Variance ($\mathrm{RSS}/n$) in Finite-Sample Wald $t$-Tests & Unsaved Normal-Approximation $p$-Values:** [`fit_pgls`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/scripts/02_pgls_ancestry_models.py#L60-L68) uses $\mathrm{RSS}/n$ instead of unbiased $\mathrm{RSS}/(n-p)$ for SEs and $t$-tests, formats small $p$-values as `0.000000` in [pgls_model_summary.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/results/pgls_model_summary.tsv), and substitutes normal-tail $p$-values in [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/DOSSIER.md#L54-L135) (e.g., $7.50 \times 10^{-13}$ vs $t_{230}$ $p = 1.88 \times 10^{-11}$ unbiased). Report unbiased SEs, $t_{0.975, n-p}$ CIs, scientific-notation TSV $p$-values, and the 95% profile-likelihood CI for $\hat{\lambda}_{\mathrm{ML}} = 0.9158$ ($[0.8466, 0.9568]$).
  3. **Post-Hoc One-Sided Hypothesis Framing:** Replace the post-hoc one-sided $H_0: \beta_{\mathrm{AAI}} \le 0$ vs $H_1: \beta_{\mathrm{AAI}} > 0$ in [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/DOSSIER.md#L54) with the pre-specified two-sided test ($H_0: \beta_{\mathrm{AAI}} = 0$ vs $H_1: \beta_{\mathrm{AAI}} \ne 0$).
  4. **Unverified Disjoint Partition ($N_{\mathrm{dark}} + N_{\mathrm{RBH}} \le N_{\mathrm{prot}}$) & Denominator Mismatch:** Remove the unverified mutual-exclusivity theorem from [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/DESIGN.md#L81), [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/DOSSIER.md#L67-L68), and [03_reconciled_coupling_and_accessory.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/scripts/03_reconciled_coupling_and_accessory.py#L52-L125) (since catalogue dark calls and single-genome Pyrodigal RBHs to GTDB/MGnify MAGs use different callers and non-exclusive definitions), and match the RBH denominator between observed and permuted ratios.
  5. **Comparator Provenance & Empirical AAI Range:** Replace "known isolate genomes" ($55\text{–}72\%$ AAI) in [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/DESIGN.md#L19) and [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_v2/DOSSIER.md#L106-L179) with external GTDB r232 and MGnify reference genomes (predominantly uncultured environmental MAGs) spanning $48.68\text{–}80.04\%$ AAI ($52.91\text{–}80.04\%$ in `SW-10-69-26` and `E2`, median $64.77\%$) per [v2_thermo_relatives_pairs.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round5/reviewer_inputs/06_darkmatter/lineage_darkness_clean/results/v2_thermo_relatives_pairs.tsv).
